This review is way overdue. Max deserves five stars. There was an issue I was having regarding a compromised balcony. Max came out to my property on extremely short notice and provided a comprehensive assessment on the work that needed to be done as well as what he perceived to be the cause. He answered all my questions, provided advice on how I should best move forward. You could tell by the way he performed his assessment that he is truly putting in effort to determine the scope and depth of the work. He also provided me with detailed report of the work that needed to be done. Max is quick to answer emails and provided me his phone number so that I could text him for a quicker responses. He is polite and professional and incredibly knowledgeable about his field. I am so incredibly grateful for Max for his help.
